episodes.title: Why Are US Politics Today So Divisive?
episodes.description: Trace party identities and ideological sorting to explore why American politics became increasingly polarized and personal.

episodes.title: Why Does the US Only Have Two Major Parties?
episodes.description: Investigate institutional rules and voter behavior that help maintain a system dominated by two parties.

episodes.title: Where Does Campaign Money Really Come From?
episodes.description: Explore campaign donations, spending rules, super PACs, and the influence of less transparent political money.

episodes.title: Why Don’t More People Vote?
episodes.description: Examine individual motivations and electoral systems that encourage participation or discourage people from voting.

episodes.title: Is the Electoral College Broken?
episodes.description: Investigate the presidential elector system, criticisms of its operation, and proposals for changing it.

episodes.title: How Big of a Problem is Voter Fraud?
episodes.description: Explore election safeguards, evidence about fraud, and the spread of misleading claims about voting.
